meta.name: gog
meta.description: Search, send, and draft Gmail messages, manage Google Calendar events, query Drive and Contacts, and read/write Google Sheets and Docs via the gog CLI. Use when the user asks to send email, check their calendar, search Drive files, read a spreadsheet, or export a Google Doc.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行管理谷歌邮件、日历、文档和表格
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在谷歌工作区中处理邮件、日程和文档
copy.tagline_en: Manage Gmail, Calendar, Drive, and Docs from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently work with Google Workspace apps like Gmail, Calendar, and Docs

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 gog 命令行工具搜索、发送和草拟 Gmail 邮件，管理 Google 日历事件，查询 Google Drive 文件和联系人，以及读写 Google 表格和文档。
howto.when: 当你要求发送邮件、查看日历、搜索 Drive 文件、读取电子表格或导出 Google 文档时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下最近一周的邮件。
say.note: Claude 会使用 gog 搜索 Gmail。

say.text: 在日历上创建一个明天下午3点的会议。
say.note: Claude 会调用 gog 创建日历事件。

say.text: 把这份 Google 文档导出为文本文件。
say.note: Claude 会使用 gog 导出文档。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search, send, and draft Gmail messages, manage Google Calendar events, query Drive and Contacts, and read/write Google Sheets and Docs via the gog CLI.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to send email, check your calendar, search Drive files, read a spreadsheet, or export a Google Doc.

say_en.text: Check my emails from the last week.
say_en.note: Claude will use gog to search Gmail.

say_en.text: Create a meeting at 3 PM tomorrow on my calendar.
say_en.note: Claude will call gog to create a calendar event.

say_en.text: Export this Google Doc as a text file.
say_en.note: Claude will use gog to export the document.
